verdicts.reason: A keeps the image, title, date block and logo legible and in a left-to-right flow, but 'EXHIBITION' is jammed vertically between the image and the date block instead of sitting above the headline, the title is pushed against the top edge, the address wraps with a single-word orphan ('Kiln Lane') and pushes into the logo column, and the date block and logo don't line up. B shrinks the date block to an unreadable tiny chip, the address, 'EXHIBITION' and logo are illegible micro text at the bottom, and the headline floats in a large empty area, so its hierarchy and readability are worse.
